build_DinoFeatureExtractor: build a DINOv2 feature extractor with a specified model variant like dinov2_vits14-reg
run_forward_feature_extraction: run forward pass on image tensors to extract cls tokens and feature maps
extract_descriptors: extract key query value or token descriptors from a specific transformer layer
change_vit_stride_resolution: change the ViT patch extraction stride to adjust output feature map resolution
register_attention_hooks: register forward hooks on transformer blocks to extract attention or token features
